Room.title: Room
Room.description: A 1v1 Quiz Duel multiplayer match room identified by a 6-character uppercase room code, storing seated players, per-tab seat IDs, heartbeats, and the deterministic action log.

roomCode.description: 6-character uppercase alphanumeric room code matching the document ID.

hostUid.description: Firebase Auth UID of the room creator (Player 1 / Seat 1).

hostSeatId.description: Per-tab seat identifier for Seat 1 so one account can test across two tabs.

hostName.description: Display name of the room creator.

guestUid.description: Firebase Auth UID of the joining opponent (Player 2 / Seat 2), or empty string while waiting.

guestSeatId.description: Per-tab seat identifier for Seat 2 so one account can test across two tabs.

guestName.description: Display name of the joining opponent, or empty string while waiting.

seed.description: Deterministic Mulberry32 PRNG seed for deck shuffle and question binding.

status.description: Current lifecycle status of the room.

actionCount.description: Number of serialized engine actions in actionLog.

actionLog.description: Bounded list (max 500) of plain serializable GameAction map objects replayed by both clients.

hostLastSeenMs.description: Epoch milliseconds of Player 1's most recent heartbeat or action (60s disconnect forfeit window).

guestLastSeenMs.description: Epoch milliseconds of Player 2's most recent heartbeat or action (60s disconnect forfeit window).

winnerSeat.description: 0 while in progress or if ended in a draw at the 500-action cap, 1 if Player 1 won, 2 if Player 2 won.

forfeitedBySeat.description: 0 if normal finish, 1 if Player 1 forfeited/disconnected, 2 if Player 2 forfeited/disconnected.

rematchCount.description: Counter incremented each time a finished match is reset for a rematch.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the room was created.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the room was last updated.

/rooms/{roomCode}.description: Multiplayer 1v1 match rooms keyed by 6-character room code.
